blocks.text: A Square in Seville. At the back are the walls of the old Arena. The entrance to the Circus is shut in by a long curtain. It is the day of the bull-fight. The square is animated. Water sellers, others with oranges, fans, etc., etc.
Officers, Frasquita, Mercedes, afterwards Carmen and Escamillo.

lines: A little fan I’ll sell you cheap.
Come here, for all you want I keep.

blocks.text: During this first chorus, the two Officers of the second Act give their arms to Frasquita and Mercedes.

lines: Who wants to know the lists?
You, there! I want to buy a fan.
Girls and lads, come here and dance
At sound so gay of tambourine we go;
Lads and lasses thus to twine.
Dance! for soon shall we see
To sound so gay of tambourine
Dance, ye nimble lads, yes, dance;
We girls will in the dance go round.”

blocks.text: Noise of trumpets heard outside. The Band arrives.

lines: Wonders will be done in Seville.
Haste! quick! all good places seek.
And the first to come, as the custom is.
See, the Alguazil, with his ugly phiz:
At him hiss till he’s out of this.
Now we’ll salute, as they pass along,
All these youths so handsome, strong;
See their banners, how they wave!
Glory and honor to the brave!
Warlike and noble seem they all,
To find their equals there’s no fear;
See their vests all shining with golden lace.
Now to the best of all give place—
Amongst them all in valor and grace,

blocks.text: Escamillo enters with Carmen, magnificently dressed.

lines: Now hail to the sword with the keenest blade
To him who can the death-stroke give,
Conq’ror most dexterous we’ll proclaim him.
Hail, Escamillo! Long may he live!
Thou wilt see me ere long yonder,
Ah! if I love thee, Escamillo?
If this heart holds other love than thine!

blocks.text: Trumpets outside. Two Trumpeters enter followed by four Alguazils.
The Orchestra play a brief march. The Alcade crosses the scene, preceded by the Alguazils, and enters into the Circus. During this Frasquita and Mercedes approach Carmen.

lines: Go far away from this place,
Lurking in the crowd, watching thee.
I know well he is there.
I am no coward to tremble at Jose.
If he will speak to me, I am here.

blocks.text: The Alcade has entered the Circus; after him the Cavalcade; then the people make their way in. Jose appears. Carmen is in a corner of the scene, and is alone with him.

lines: I was warned that you were not far off—
It was even said, “Fear for thy life!”
But I do not fear! and I will not fly!
We, Carmen, ought now a new life begin
Far from here, beneath another sky.
What you ask ’tis vain to hope for.
Between us, Jose, all is ended.
Carmen, hear me! Yet there is time:
My Carmen: I would save thee!
No! I know well the hour has come,
But if I live, or if I perish—
Ah! why yet seek a heart not thine?
Jose, in vain thou dost adore me!
Ah! Carmen to save thee yet there’s time!
Thou knowest my heart ever must adore thee!
Thy heart owns no longer love for me?
No, no, I love thee not!
Spite of this, Carmen, I love thee yet!
What worth thy love if ’tis not shared?
And worse! but abandon me not!
Carmen, no! thou canst not forget me!
Free was I born! free will I die!

blocks.text: Noise of trumpets in the Circus.

lines: Mad with anger goes the bull

blocks.text: During the Chorus, Jose and Carmen are silent, they listen. At the shouts of victory, a cry of joy escapes from Carmen. Jose observes it. At the end of the chorus, Carmen moves towards the Circus.

lines: That man they now so loudly applaud,
Thou shalt not with him go.
Leave me, Don Jose! with thee I will not come.
Thou goest to meet him! Thou lovest him then?
I love him! I love him, and die I must,
I love him, and to you declare it.

blocks.text: Noise of trumpets and chorus again in circus.

lines: Inhuman girl! For thy sake am I lost!
And then to know thee shameless, infamous!
Laughing in his arms at my despair!
No, no! it shall not be, by Heaven!
Carmen, thou must be mine, mine only!
Ah! weary am I of threats.
This ring thou one day on my finger plac’d.

blocks.text: Rushes to Carmen, who draws back. Noise in Circus.

lines: Do not forget the brightest of eyes,

blocks.text: Jose stabs Carmen, who falls dead. The curtain of the Circus is opened and the crowd come from the Circus.

lines: I yield me prisoner. I have killed her!

blocks.text: Escamillo appears on the steps of the Circus. Jose throws himself near Carmen’s body.
